hostname ix-r21
!
ip access-list ACL-R-PBR permit ip src 198.51.100.0/25 dest any
ip prefix-list pl-r-in 5 permit 0.0.0.0/0 max 24
ip prefix-list pl-r-out 5 permit 198.51.100.0/24
!
route-map RM-R-IN permit 10
  match ip address prefix-list pl-r-in
  match community 64497:100 no-export-subconfed
  set local-preference 200
!
route-map RM-R-IN permit 20
  match ip address prefix-list pl-r-in
!
route-map RM-R-O2B permit 10
  set metric 100
!
route-map RM-R-OUT permit 10
  match ip address prefix-list pl-r-out
  set as-path prepend 64496 64496
  set community 64496:50 additive
  set metric 50
!
route-map RM-R-PBR permit 10
  match ip address access-list ACL-R-PBR
  set ip next-hop 203.0.113.2
!
route-map RM-R-STATIC permit 10
  match tag 100
  set metric-type type-1
!
ip route 192.0.2.64/26 198.51.100.254 tag 100
ip route 192.0.2.128/26 198.51.100.253
!
ip router ospf 1
  router-id 192.0.2.1
  redistribute static metric 20 metric-type 1 tag 100 route-map RM-R-STATIC
  network GigaEthernet1.0 area 0
!
router bgp 64496
  router-id 192.0.2.1
  neighbor 203.0.113.2 remote-as 64497
  address-family ipv4 unicast
    network 198.51.100.0/24
    redistribute ospf 1 route-map RM-R-O2B
    neighbor 203.0.113.2 route-map RM-R-IN in
    neighbor 203.0.113.2 route-map RM-R-OUT out
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  description to sample upstream
  ip address 203.0.113.1/30
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  description sample lan
  ip address 198.51.100.1/24
  ip policy route-map RM-R-PBR
  ip ospf hello-interval 10
  ip ospf dead-interval 40
  no shutdown
!
interface Loopback0.0
  description sample id
  ip address 192.0.2.1/32
!
